answer: Sybil resistance comes from proof-of-work identity registration: each agent must burn compute to mint a unique onyx credential bound to its keypair. The beacon broadcasts epoch challenges, and peers verify work prior to attestation. Duplicate identities require repeating the full burn per sybil, making mass forgery economically prohibitive. Honest agents stake a willow bond that slashes on proven duplication, so attackers lose both compute and collateral with every fake identity. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
